• Inter Kashi FC vs Sporting Club Delhi || Highlights || Match 27 || 07-Nov-2026 || English ||
Delhi are on a roll! Watch the big moments as Sporting Club Delhi beat Inter Kashi FC 3-0 in Pune for back-to-back wins in the MG Indian Super League 2026-27.
Carlos Fortes struck early from Rodriguinho’s pass, and Delhi held that lead until the final 20 minutes. Juan Peña then doubled it from Manoj Mohammed’s ball, and Rodriguinho capped a standout display with the third.
Match highlight: Peña has scored in three games in a row, and Delhi kept their first clean sheet of the season.
